Zero gap. Collapsed / flush elements, no visual separation.
Micro gap. Icon-to-label distance, inline tag padding, tightest intentional spacing on a 4px grid.
Small gap. Default inline spacing between sibling elements — button groups, tag rows, form field vertical gap in compact layouts.
Medium-small gap. Input internal padding, nav item horizontal spacing, card internal column gaps.
Base unit. Card padding, section padding on mobile, default vertical flow between content blocks. Matches input padding-LR from original system.
Content group gap. Matches body-md/title-md line-height. Used for spacing between logical groups within a section (e.g., form group to form group).
Large gap. Card padding on desktop, major stack gaps. Matches headline-md/title-lg line-height — keeps vertical rhythm coherent.
Section gap. Space between distinct content sections on a page. Large card internal padding on desktop.
Display-level gap. Matches display-lg line-height. Hero element spacing, major group separators.
Page section spacing. The primary "big break" between page-level regions (e.g., header → content → footer).
Major page division. Full-bleed section spacing on desktop, wide-screen page margins.
Hero spacing. Landing page vertical breathing room, above-the-fold hero to content gap.
Maximum standard spacing. Splash pages, marketing sections, feature showcases. Matches icon-size-xl.
Extreme spacing. Full-page hero sections, landing page dramatic gaps. Use sparingly.
Inline icons in body text, status dots adjacent to labels, tiny affordances.
Default UI icon. Navigation items, action buttons, form field icons. Fits within 32px touch targets.
Emphasized icon. Empty state illustrations, feature card icons, onboarding step indicators.
Large icon. Category thumbnails, profile avatars in headers, prominent feature icons. Meets minimum touch target (48dp Android / 44pt iOS).
Display icon. Hero illustrations, empty state artwork, splash screen brand marks.
Hairline stroke. xs icons — keeps proportional visual weight at small sizes.
